violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: deli sliced ham (46F) and deli sliced turkey (48F) in two overfilled containers inside the Bison 3 Dr preptop refigerator on the prepline.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. CDI: CFM removed half the portion of both the deli sliced ham and turkey and placed in separate containers (not overfilled) and placed in the walk in refrigerator to cool to 41F or below.

violations.title: RTE TCS Food Prepared On Site, Date Marking
violations.observation: The following refrigerated, ready-to-eat, time/temperature control for safety food that is prepared on site is not used or discarded within 24 hours of preparation and was not observed to be date marked: premade individually plastic wrapped lasagna squares/ portions and portioned sliced deli cheeses (Swiss , cheddar, pepper jack) inside the walk-in refrigerator.
violations.corrective_action: Refrigerated, ready-to-eat, time/temperature control for safety foods that are prepared on site and kept for more than 24 hours cannot have a shelf-life of more than 7 days, including the day of preparation. These food items must be marked with either the 'consume-by' date and/or 'preparation' date, color-coded labels, or another marking system/method that effectively indicates shelf-life that is clearly understood and properly used by the employees. CDI: CFM placed date marked labels (5 remaining days) on the premade individually plastic wrapped lasagna squares/ portions and portioned sliced deli cheeses (Swiss , cheddar, pepper jack) inside the walk-in refrigerator with remaining hold dates before discard.

violations.title: Food Storage Container, Common Name
violations.observation: The following food items that are not easily identified by appearance were observed without a label: no label seasonings and spice (black ground pepper, yeast, cinnamon, pumpkin seeds, pistachios nuts, walnuts, oregano etc.) and plastic squeeze bottles (water, brown sauce, red wine vinegar, etc,) and bulk dry food items bins (flour, sugar) throughout the main kitchen.
violations.corrective_action: Unless a food item can be easily recognized, all foods and ingredients removed from their original containers and stored in working containers shall be labeled using the common name of the food. For example: cooking oils, salt, sugar, flour, spices, herbs, etc. EHS instructed CFM to label all food items removed from its original container with common food name.

out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Equipment, Maintain in Good Repair/Condition
violations.observation: The following equipment is not operating properly and/or is in poor repair: minor leak at the pipe under the sanitizer sink basin at the 3 vat sink in the main kitchen.
violations.corrective_action: Equipment shall be maintained in a state of repair and condition that meets the requirements specified under Parts 4-1 and 4-2. EHS instructed CFM to schedule repair on leak under the sanitizer sink basin at the 3 vat sink in the main kitchen.

violations.title: Food-Contact Surfaces, Corrosion-Resistant/Nonabsorbent Materials
violations.observation: The food-contact surfaces of the following equipment and/or utensils are not durable: cart shelves lined with aluminum foil on prepline in main kitchen.
violations.corrective_action: Materials that are used in the construction of utensils and food-contact surfaces of equipment may not allow the migration of deleterious substances or impart colors, odors, or tastes to food and under normal use conditions shall be durable, corrosion-resistant, and nonabsorbent. EHS instructed CFM to remove aluminum foil form cart shelves to allow for easy cleaning.

out_items.name: Management, food employee and conditional employee; knowledge, responsibilities and reporting

violations.title: Duty of PIC, Employee Health Policy in Place
violations.observation: Upon discussion with the person-in-charge, one or more of the elements of an effective employee health policy is either missing or incomplete. A complete employee health policy is required to be in place at the food establishment. At the time of this inspection, the Health Department provided and reviewed handouts and resource information in a red folder labeled 'Employee Health Policy.'
violations.corrective_action: A complete employee health policy must have the following elements: 1) Employee training on foodborne illness, particularly symptoms of illness and prevention of the Big Six illnesses (see 'What is Foodborne Illness' handout); and 2) Documentation that employees have been instructed of their responsibility to report symptoms of, diagnosis of or exposure to foodborne illness to management (see 'Employee Illness Reporting Agreement' handout); and 3) A management plan to restrict or exclude employees, as applicable, who have symptoms, diagnosis or exposure to foodborne illness (see 'Employee Illness Decision Guide for PIC/CFM' handout). The information provided at the time of this inspection will help you develop and implement this policy. Handouts are available in the following languages: English, Arabic, Chinese (traditional), Farsi, Hindi, Korean, Spanish, Thai, Urdu and Vietnamese. If you have any questions about your employee health policy, please contact your area inspector or contact the Health Department at 703-246-2201, TTY 703-591-6435. CDI: EHS emailed CFM copy of employee health policy to review information with food employee, sign the document, and maintain on file for future reference. Nozzo Pazzo (Inspection Date: 04/28/2026) Page 2 of 3

out_items.name: Consumer advisory provided for raw and undercooked food

violations.title: Consumer Advisory for Raw/Undercooked Food, Reminder
violations.observation: The following raw and/or undercooked foods are provided on the menu, menu board, table tent or brochure without a reminder and disclosure statement: Cesar salad dressing prepared with raw shelled egg.
violations.corrective_action: The Consumer Advisory shall include a reminder statement that includes asterisking (*) the animal-derived foods requiring disclosure to a footnote that states one of the following: 1) 'Regarding the safety of these items, written information is available upon request', or 2) 'Consuming raw or undercooked meats, seafood, shellfish, or eggs may increase your risk of foodborne illness', or 3) 'Consuming raw or undercooked meats, seafood, shellfish, or eggs may increase your risk of foodborne illness, especially if you have certain medical conditions'. EHS instructed CFM to place consumer advisory reminder and disclosure statement on the salad page of the menu.

out_items.name: Contamination prevented during food preparation, storage, and display

violations.title: Food Storage Prohibited under Sewer Lines
violations.observation: Food ( boxes of prepackaged cups/ packs of condiments (mustard dressing/ dipping sauces) stored under the cabinet at the front hand sink (under sewer lines).
violations.corrective_action: Food may not be stored under sewer lines that are not shielded to intercept potential drips. CDI: EHS instructed CFM to relocate box of condiments to dry storage. Area.

out_items.name: Utensils, equipment and linens properly stored, dried and handled

violations.title: Equip/Utensils Self-Draining Position/Covered/Inverted
violations.observation: Observed clean ice bin not stored inverted in the back kitchen area near the 2 Dr sliding glass UR refrigerator.
violations.corrective_action: Clean equipment and utensils shall be stored covered or inverted to prevent contamination. CDI: CFM washed, rinsed, and sanitized the ice bin before being stored inverted on clean food contact surface.

out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Access to Handwashing Sink
violations.observation: The handwashing facility located at the back kitchen area is blocked by bowls and plate stored is the sink basin, preventing access by employees for easy handwashing.
violations.corrective_action: A hand washing sink shall be maintained so that it is accessible at all times for employee use. CDI: CDI removed bowls and plate from hand sink.

violations.title: Separation of Raw Animal and RTE Foods
violations.observation: Raw animal food storage, preparation, holding or display conducted in a manner that may cause cross contamination of ready-to-eat food as follows: multiple cartons of shelled eggs stored directly above cartons of liquid pasteurized eggs and uncooked spinach inside the walk in refrigerator.
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from cross contamination by separating raw animal foods like poultry, beef, pork, seafood, and eggs from cooked foods, ready-to- eat foods, washed produce, etc during storage, preparation, holding or display. Raw foods shall be stored on shelving units BELOW or SEPARATED from all cooked foods, commercially processed foods, washed produce, leftover foods, etc. CFM relocated all cartons of eggs to the bottom shelf inside the walk in refrigerator.

out_items.name: Utensils, equipment and linens properly stored, dried and handled

violations.title: Equip/Utensils/Linens Stored off Floor, Clean Location
violations.observation: Observed that several clean stacked sheet pans on the clean side of the 3 compartment directly next to the hand sink and soap dispenser, stored in an manner that exposed the items to splashing and possible contamination.
violations.corrective_action: Store clean equipment, utensils, and linens in a clean, dry location where they are not exposed to splash, dust, or other contamination and at least 6 inches above the floor. CDI: CFM will designate the other side of the 3 compartment as the clean side, away from the designated hand sink.

violations.title: Hot Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed hot holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: Vegetables chicken lentil soup=132F
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature conrol for safety food shall be held hot at a temperature of 135F or above unless the permit holder is using 'time as the public health control' as specified under 3-501.19. reheated on stove, to 185 during the inspection .

out_items.name: Insects, rodents, and animals not present

violations.title: Openings Protected from Pest Entry
violations.observation: Front entry door kept open for ventilation or other purposes do not have openings that are adequately protected against the entry of insects or rodents
violations.corrective_action: Windows or doors kept open for ventilation or other purposes shall have openings that are adequately protected against the entry of insects or rodents by 1) 16 mesh to 25.4mm (16 mesh to 1 inch) screens; 2) properly designed and installed air curtains to control flying insects; or 3) other effective means. Front Door closed during the inspection.

violations.title: Openings Protected from Pest Entry
violations.observation: Openings to the exterior of the building are present along the base of the back door entrance to the kitchen.
violations.corrective_action: Fill or close holes and other gaps along floors, walls, and ceilings to protect against the entry of insects and rodents. Install a weather stripping at a the base of the backl door to seal the existing gap, prevent entry of pests. Nozzo Pazzo (Inspection Date: 10/29/2024) Page 2 of 3

out_items.name: Contamination prevented during food preparation, storage, and display

violations.title: Food Storage 6 inches above Floor
violations.observation: Food stored on the floor and/or food stored less than 6 inches off the floor. Food supplies were observed stored on floor or less than 6 inches off the the floor in the walk-in freezer and dry storage areas or hallways.
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from contamination by storing the food at least 6 inches off the floor on approved shelving units or dunnage racks. Milk crates, soda crates, or bread racks are not suitable for food storage. Provide dunnage racks to storage food supplies off the floors.

out_items.name: Wiping cloths properly used and stored

violations.title: Wipings Clothes Stored in Sanitizer Solution
violations.observation: Wet wiping cloths used for wiping counters and other equipment surfaces were observed stored on the counter.
violations.corrective_action: Wet wiping cloths are to be used for wiping counters and other equipment surfaces and are to be held in a chemical sanitizer solution at the appropriate concentration between uses. After each use, soak wet wiping towels in sanitizing solution. Do not place the wet towels on counter tops or on cutting boards.

violations.title: Plumbing System, Maintain Good Repair
violations.observation: Plumbing connections under the 3-compartment sink piping is leaking. The hot water at the hand washing sink located at the front serving station is less that 100F below the minimum required temperature.
violations.corrective_action: A plumbing system shall be maintained in good repair. adjust the hot water temperature at this front hand washing sink to at least 100F , for proper hand washing by food handlers to prevent possible food contamination..
